Owner report 17 Oct: with Objects on, clicking Bosses & rares leaves the object pins on the map; expected only bosses and rares. Cause: Bosses & rares / All NPCs is the NPC-layer scope pair while Objects and Quests are independent layers. Ruling: Bosses & rares acts as a 'just the notable NPCs' preset that switches the other layers off; folded into 3B Task 8 (map layers and legend toggles).
